The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mical]] left an '''archive''' in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] that contained his [[Mical's holocron|holocron]] and a wealth of knowledge. It was attacked and devastated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but archaeologists later discovered Mical's holocron preserved intact among what survived within the archive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Legacy of Master Mical" />
